title: DHCPv6: Take subset tvbs; show why dissection stops on bad length
description:
Take subset TVBs instead of passing around end offset everywhere.
Use a FT_NONE where appropriate instead of a FT_STRING; keep the
FT_STRING around hidden for backwards compatibility (but note
that the filtering engine supports filtering on value string
values.)

Instead of just stopping dissection with a bogus option length
value, insert an expert info in the tree. Ping #21160. Make a
few unsigned values unsigned.

AI-Assisted: no
